description: Set paragraph formatting on text: indents and spacing, alignment, justification, hyphenation, keep options, rules above and below, borders and shading, span and split columns, drop caps and nested styles (Paragraph panel and its menu: Justification, Hyphenation, Keep Options, Paragraph Rules, Paragraph Borders and Shading, Span Columns, Drop Caps and Nested Styles). Only the options given change. Distances are mm, line weights points

alignment.description: Paragraph alignment (TO_BINDING_SIDE and AWAY_FROM_BINDING_SIDE follow the spine)

border.description: Paragraph border (Paragraph panel menu > Paragraph Borders and Shading)

bottomEdge.description: Where the border ends at the bottom (Bottom Edge)

color.description: Border colour: a swatch name in the document, "None", or "#RRGGBB" (creates an RGB colour swatch)

corners.description: Border corners: option and radius for all four corners, and optionally per corner

displayIfSplits.description: Display the border if the paragraph splits across frames or columns

gapColor.description: Colour of the gaps in dashed, dotted or striped borders: a swatch name in the document, "None", or "#RRGGBB" (creates an RGB colour swatch)

offsets.description: Border offsets from the text (mm); give any of top, left, bottom, right

on.description: Turn the border on or off

topEdge.description: Where the border starts at the top (Top Edge)

type.description: Stroke type by name, as in the Stroke panel (Solid, Dashed, Dotted, Thick - Thin, ...)

weights.description: Stroke weight of each side (points); give any of top, left, bottom, right

width.description: Border width: the column or the text

columns.description: Span or split columns (Paragraph panel menu > Span Columns)

count.description: Columns to span, or sub-columns to split into (1-40), or "all" to span every column

spaceAfter.description: Space after the span or split (mm)

spaceBefore.description: Space before the span or split (mm)

dropCap.description: Drop caps (Paragraph panel; Paragraph panel menu > Drop Caps and Nested Styles)

alignLeftEdge.description: Align the drop cap to the left edge

characterStyle.description: Character style for the drop cap (a name, or "[None]")

lines.description: Drop cap height in lines (0 for none)

scaleForDescenders.description: Scale the drop cap for descenders

lastWord.description: Hyphenate the last word of a paragraph

limit.description: Hyphen limit: consecutive hyphens (0 for no limit)

style.description: Hyphenation style for the Duden dictionary (German)

wordsLongerThan.description: Words with at least this many letters

indents.description: Indents and spacing (Paragraph panel; Paragraph Formatting > Indents and Spacing)

alignToGrid.description: Align to baseline grid (Align to Grid)

firstLineOnlyToGrid.description: Only align the first line to the grid

sameStyleSpacing.description: Space between paragraphs using the same style, in mm, or "ignore" to use space before and after

autoLeading.description: Auto leading, percent of the type size

glyphScaling.description: Glyph scaling, percent: minimum, desired and maximum

letterSpacing.description: Letter spacing, percent: minimum, desired and maximum

singleWordJustification.description: How a line holding a single word is justified

wordSpacing.description: Word spacing, percent of a normal space: minimum, desired and maximum

keep.description: Keep options (Paragraph panel menu > Keep Options)

allLines.description: true: all lines in paragraph; false: at start/end of paragraph

endLines.description: At end of paragraph: keep this many lines together

startLines.description: At start of paragraph: keep this many lines together

nestedLineStyles.description: Nested line styles (Drop Caps and Nested Styles); replaces the paragraphs' nested line styles, [] clears them

nestedStyles.description: Nested styles (Drop Caps and Nested Styles); replaces the paragraphs' nested styles, [] clears them

characters.description: Or: end at these literal characters (1 to 10)

inclusive.description: true: through the delimiter (default); false: up to it

ruleAbove.description: Rule above (Paragraph panel menu > Paragraph Rules)

color.description: Rule colour: a swatch name in the document, "None", or "#RRGGBB" (creates an RGB colour swatch)

gapColor.description: Colour of the gaps in dashed, dotted or striped rules: a swatch name in the document, "None", or "#RRGGBB" (creates an RGB colour swatch)

keepInFrame.description: Keep the rule above inside the frame (Keep In Frame)

offset.description: Offset from the baseline of the first line (mm)

on.description: Turn the rule above on or off (Rule On)

type.description: Stroke type by name, as in the Stroke panel (Solid, Dashed, Dotted, Thick - Thin, ...)

width.description: Rule width: the column or the text

ruleBelow.description: Rule below (Paragraph panel menu > Paragraph Rules)

color.description: Rule colour: a swatch name in the document, "None", or "#RRGGBB" (creates an RGB colour swatch)

gapColor.description: Colour of the gaps in dashed, dotted or striped rules: a swatch name in the document, "None", or "#RRGGBB" (creates an RGB colour swatch)

offset.description: Offset from the baseline of the last line (mm)

on.description: Turn the rule below on or off (Rule On)

type.description: Stroke type by name, as in the Stroke panel (Solid, Dashed, Dotted, Thick - Thin, ...)

width.description: Rule width: the column or the text

shading.description: Paragraph shading (Paragraph panel menu > Paragraph Borders and Shading)

bottomEdge.description: Where the shading ends at the bottom (Bottom Edge)

clipToFrame.description: Clip the shading to the frame

color.description: Shading colour: a swatch name in the document, "None", or "#RRGGBB" (creates an RGB colour swatch)

corners.description: Shading corners: option and radius for all four corners, and optionally per corner

offsets.description: Shading offsets from the text (mm); give any of top, left, bottom, right

on.description: Turn the shading on or off

suppressPrinting.description: Do not print or export the shading

topEdge.description: Where the shading starts at the top (Top Edge)

width.description: Shading width: the column or the text

target.description: Which text to act on. Give storyIds (get_document_stories), frameIds (text frame ids from list_page_items), or selection: true; optionally narrow to a range of paragraphs

frameIds.description: Text frames, by page item id: the text in each frame

paragraphs.description: Only these paragraphs of each text (0-based)

count.description: How many paragraphs (default: to the end)

selection.description: Use the selected text, or the text of the selected text frames

wholeStory.description: Widen frames and selected text to their whole stories

name: set_paragraph_formatting
title: Set Paragraph Formatting
